input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for rest response entity exception handler, custom oauth 2user, custom oidc user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to use rest response entity exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use oauth 2authentication success handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use local user detail capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use user capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
